sources.title: GitHub - IBM/gguf: IBM GGUF-encoded AI models and conversion scripts
sources.snippet: This repository provides an automated CI/CD process to convert, test and deploy IBM Granite models, in safetensor format, from the ibm-granite organization to IBM GGUF versions (with various supported quantizations) within model repositories respectively named with the -GGUF extension. These GGUF model repositories are also included to the Granite Quantized Model collection for convenience.

sources.title: Where to Download GGUF Models - Best Sources & Direct Links (2025)
